items.q: Do I need a visa for Kyrgyzstan?
items.a: Citizens of many countries, including the EU, the UK, the USA and CIS countries, can enter visa-free — usually for up to 60 days. Rules change, so check them for your country on an official website before you travel.
Kyrgyzstan is a welcoming and calm country for travellers. In the mountains experience and gear matter, so we run challenging routes with experienced guides.

items.q: How do I get from the airport?
items.a: Manas International Airport is about 25–30 km from Bishkek. We meet guests at the airport and arrange the transfer.
The national currency is the Kyrgyz som (KGS). It's easy to bring US dollars or euros and exchange them in Bishkek. Cards work in cities; in the mountains and villages you need cash.
Yes. In winter there are ski resorts (for example in Karakol), and the mountains and gorges look completely different.

items.q: Is Kyrgyzstan good for a trip with children?
items.a: Yes. There are relaxed routes with comfortable hotels and short drives — we will match the programme to your children's age.
